## Notes

- Webshop.Desktop builds only on Windows. Elsewhere build the other projects one by one (Webshop.Business/Webshop.Business.csproj, Webshop.Desktop.Core/Webshop.Desktop.Core.csproj, Webshop.Repositrory/Webshop.Repositrory.csproj) and list the rest as not checkable.
- Nullable reference types are off in some projects: the compiler does not check null flow there. See `kit contract nullability-across-layers`.
